visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Start Node Is Not Marked
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Starting from node 0 the order should be 0 1 2 3 4, but node 0 appears a second time.

solution.explanation: Every node that enters the queue must be marked at the same moment, including the start node. If it is not marked, its neighbours see it as unvisited and put it into the queue again.
